{{Top|leg}}
'''Lovvrenk''' was an individual who once traveled to [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] with a supposed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], hoping to spot a [[Shadow hunter]]. There, a [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] took Lovvrenk's leg, but the Jedi wounded it and dragged Lovvrenk to safety.<ref name="F&D CR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Lovvrenk was first mentioned in [[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]] in a captain's log.
